```{r color definitions and basic functions}
#a function to convert a vector from raw p-values to significance symbols
sig_conversion <- function(misc_dataframe) {
  triple <- misc_dataframe <= 0.001
  double <- misc_dataframe >= 0.001 & misc_dataframe<0.01 
  single <- misc_dataframe >= 0.01 & misc_dataframe<0.05 
  nonsig <- misc_dataframe >= 0.05 
  misc_dataframe[single] <- "*"
  misc_dataframe[double] <- "**"
  misc_dataframe[triple] <- "***"
  misc_dataframe[nonsig] <- "n.s."
  print(misc_dataframe)
}

# function to calculate SEM
calculate_sem <- function(vector_of_interest) {
  vector_of_interest_no_NAs <- na.omit(vector_of_interest)
  sd(vector_of_interest_no_NAs)/sqrt(length((vector_of_interest_no_NAs)))
}

#set figure export dimensions
half_plot_width <- 3.25
full_plot_width <- 6.75
half_plot_height <- 3
full_plot_height <- 6

# set paper wide colors
all_pop_colors <- c(MBS = "#254869",
                    SM = "#018394",
                    LL = "#eca72c",
                    KN = "#8e260b",
                    BW = "#c65f20")

MBS_control_color <- "#5DA6EA"
MBS_2day_color    <- "#2688E3"
MBS_2wk_color     <- "#135490"
MBS_6wk_color     <- "#0D3B66"

KN_control_color <- "#F95738"
KN_2day_color    <- "#ED2E07"
KN_2wk_color     <- "#C62606"
KN_6wk_color     <- "#8B1B04"

leu_color <- "#EEE7EC"
man_color <- "#DBD0D7"

# factor ordering
strains <- c("BW", "LL", "KN", "MBS", "SM")
acclimations <- c("Control", "2day", "2wk", "6wk")

tmp_combinations <- crossing(strains, acclimations)
treatments <- paste(tmp_combinations$strains, tmp_combinations$acclimations, sep = "_")
#SM 2 weeks not actually done
treatments <- treatments[!treatments %in% "SM_2wk"]
```

```{r import-phenotypes-from-focal-and-extended comparisons}
# import phenotypes
phenotypes <- read.csv(file = "reference_files/Peromyscus_acclimation_data_phenotypes_21Jul26.csv")
keep_variables <- c("date", "acclimation", "mouse_id", "strain", "family", "indiv", "sex", "mass", "nose2base", "tail", "length", "rt.foot", "left.ear", "testis1", "testis2", "sv", "bat", "wat", "total_count", "rows_counted", "count_dilution", "avg_area_tubule",  "avg_diameterlong_tubule", "avg_diametershort_tubule", "avg_perimeter_tubule")
phenotypes <- phenotypes[,colnames(phenotypes) %in% keep_variables]
phenotypes$strain <- gsub("ME", "MBS", phenotypes$strain)
phenotypes$mouse_id <- gsub("ME", "MBS", phenotypes$mouse_id)
phenotypes$avg_area_tubule <- phenotypes$avg_area_tubule/1000000

#remove females and individuals with collection issues
phenotypes <- phenotypes[phenotypes$sex == "M",]
premature_death <- c("MBS_F5_812_E")
no_preweigh <- c("LL_01_15M")
no_SV <- c("LL_01_73M", "SM_01_91M")

#only one testis measured for this mouse; assume equal testis weight for RTW calculation
only_one_testis <- c("SM_01_08M")
phenotypes[phenotypes$mouse_id == only_one_testis,]$testis1 <- phenotypes[phenotypes$mouse_id == only_one_testis,]$testis2

# remove individuals lacking either testis weight or SV weight
#rm_individuals <- c(premature_death, no_preweigh, weird_KN, no_SV)
rm_individuals <- c(premature_death, no_preweigh, no_SV)
phenotypes <- phenotypes[!phenotypes$mouse_id %in% rm_individuals,]

#calculate fertility metrics
phenotypes$paired_TW <- (phenotypes$testis1 + phenotypes$testis2)

phenotypes$RelativeTestesWeight <- ((100 * phenotypes$paired_TW) / 
                                      phenotypes$mass )
phenotypes$RelativeSVWeight <- ((100 * phenotypes$sv) / 
                                  phenotypes$mass )
phenotypes$Fat_Proportions <- ((100 * phenotypes$wat) / 
                                 phenotypes$mass )
phenotypes$Relative_Fat_Browness <- (phenotypes$bat) / 
  (phenotypes$bat + phenotypes$wat)

phenotypes$Normalized_Sperm_Count <- (phenotypes$total_count*((30+phenotypes$count_dilution)/30))/
  phenotypes$row

#add in metadata info
phenotypes$acclimation <- gsub("3wk", "2wk", phenotypes$acclimation)
phenotypes$acclimation <- gsub("2day ", "2day", phenotypes$acclimation)
phenotypes$comp <- paste(phenotypes$strain, phenotypes$acclimation, sep = "_")
phenotypes$comp <- factor(phenotypes$comp, levels = treatments)
phenotypes$acclimation <- factor(phenotypes$acclimation, levels = acclimations)
phenotypes$strain <- factor(phenotypes$strain, levels = strains)

#make a quantitative version of acclimation; replace with actual dates at a later time
phenotypes$acclimation_quant <- phenotypes$acclimation
phenotypes$acclimation_quant <- gsub("Control", 0, phenotypes$acclimation_quant)
phenotypes$acclimation_quant <- gsub("2day", 2, phenotypes$acclimation_quant)
phenotypes$acclimation_quant <- gsub("2wk", 14, phenotypes$acclimation_quant)
phenotypes$acclimation_quant <- gsub("6wk", 56, phenotypes$acclimation_quant)
phenotypes$acclimation_quant <- as.numeric(phenotypes$acclimation_quant)

#annotate strains as high or low elevation
elevations <- data.frame(strain = c("BW", "LL", "KN", "MBS", "SM"),
                         elevation = c("low", "low", "low", "high", "high"))

phenotypes <- merge(phenotypes, elevations, by = "strain")
phenotypes$elevation <- factor(phenotypes$elevation, levels = c("low", "high"))
```

```{r import-DU-colony-records}
#import DU colony records
KN_MBS_records <- read.csv("reference_files/KN_ME_mouse_records.csv", header = TRUE)
KN_MBS_records$Individual <- toupper(KN_MBS_records$Individual)
KN_MBS_records$Strain <- gsub("ME", "MBS", KN_MBS_records$Strain)

KN_MBS_records$mouse_id <- paste(KN_MBS_records$Strain, "_", KN_MBS_records$Generation, "_",
                                 KN_MBS_records$Family, "_", KN_MBS_records$Individual,
                                 sep = "")

#date at time of experiment calculations
KN_MBS_records <- KN_MBS_records[,c("DOB", "mouse_id", "sampled.on.date")]

KN_MBS_records <- KN_MBS_records %>%
  mutate(
    DOB_parsed = mdy(DOB),
    sampled_parsed = mdy(sampled.on.date),  
    age_days = as.numeric(sampled_parsed - DOB_parsed),
    age_weeks = age_days / 7,
    age_months = age_days / 30.44,
    age_years = age_days / 365.25
  )

# import DU colony data on stock center peros
stock_center_records <- read.csv("reference_files/Pero_stock_center_mouse_records.csv", header = TRUE)

stock_center_records <- stock_center_records[,c("DOB", "Mouse_ID", "Dissection_Date")]
colnames(stock_center_records) <- gsub("Mouse_ID", "mouse_id", colnames(stock_center_records))
colnames(stock_center_records) <- gsub("Dissection_Date", "sampled.on.date", colnames(stock_center_records))

# calculate age at time of experiment
stock_center_records <- stock_center_records %>%
  mutate(
    DOB_parsed = mdy(DOB),
    sampled_parsed = mdy(sampled.on.date),  
    age_days = as.numeric(sampled_parsed - DOB_parsed),
    age_weeks = age_days / 7,
    age_months = age_days / 30.44,   # average month length
    age_years = age_days / 365.25
  )

phenotypes <- merge(phenotypes, rbind(KN_MBS_records, stock_center_records), 
                    by = "mouse_id",
                    all.x = TRUE)

# visualize age differences across strains
ggplot(phenotypes, aes(x = strain, y = age_days, color = acclimation)) +
  geom_violin() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ acclimation)

#age stats
paste("MBS mice were on average ",
      round(mean(phenotypes[phenotypes$strain == "MBS" & !(is.na(phenotypes$total_count)),]$age_days),0),
      " +/- ",
      round(calculate_sem(phenotypes[phenotypes$strain == "MBS" & !(is.na(phenotypes$total_count)),]$age_days),0),
      " days old at the time of the experiment",
      sep = "")

paste("SM mice were on average ",
      round(mean(phenotypes[phenotypes$strain == "SM" & !(is.na(phenotypes$RelativeTestesWeight)),]$age_days),0),
      " +/- ",
      round(calculate_sem(phenotypes[phenotypes$strain == "SM" & !(is.na(phenotypes$RelativeTestesWeight)),]$age_days),0),
      " days old at the time of the experiment",
      sep = "")

paste("KN mice were on average ",
      round(mean(phenotypes[phenotypes$strain == "KN" & !(is.na(phenotypes$total_count)),]$age_days),0),
      " +/- ",
      round(calculate_sem(phenotypes[phenotypes$strain == "KN" & !(is.na(phenotypes$total_count)),]$age_days),0),
      " days old at the time of the experiment",
      sep = "")

paste("BW mice were on average ",
      round(mean(phenotypes[phenotypes$strain == "BW" & !(is.na(phenotypes$RelativeTestesWeight)),]$age_days),0),
      " +/- ",
      round(calculate_sem(phenotypes[phenotypes$strain == "BW" & !(is.na(phenotypes$RelativeTestesWeight)),]$age_days),0),
      " days old at the time of the experiment",
      sep = "")

paste("LL mice were on average ",
      round(mean(phenotypes[phenotypes$strain == "LL" & !(is.na(phenotypes$RelativeTestesWeight)),]$age_days),0),
      " +/- ",
      round(calculate_sem(phenotypes[phenotypes$strain == "LL" & !(is.na(phenotypes$RelativeTestesWeight)),]$age_days),0),
      " days old at the time of the experiment",

write.csv(x = phenotypes, file = "exported_files/high_elevation_male_fertility_phenotypes_post-processing.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r calculate-summary-statistics}
#calculate the mean & sem RelativeTestesWeight for each comparison
RTW_means <- round(tapply(phenotypes$RelativeTestesWeight, 
                          phenotypes$comp, mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
RTW_sem <- round(tapply(phenotypes$RelativeTestesWeight, 
                        phenotypes$comp, calculate_sem), 3)

RTW_stats_df <- data.frame(comp = levels(phenotypes$comp),
                           RTW_means = RTW_means,
                           RTW_sem = RTW_sem)

phenotypes <- merge(phenotypes, RTW_stats_df, by = "comp", all = TRUE)


#calculate the mean & sem Normalized_Sperm_Count for each comparison
NSC_means <- round(tapply(phenotypes$Normalized_Sperm_Count, 
                          phenotypes$comp, mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
NSC_sem <- round(tapply(phenotypes$Normalized_Sperm_Count, 
                        phenotypes$comp, calculate_sem), 3)

NSC_stats_df <- data.frame(comp = levels(phenotypes$comp),
                           NSC_means = NSC_means,
                           NSC_sem = NSC_sem)

phenotypes <- merge(phenotypes, NSC_stats_df, by = "comp", all = TRUE)


#calculate the mean & sem RelativeSVWeight for each comparison
RSVW_means <- round(tapply(phenotypes$RelativeSVWeight, 
                           phenotypes$comp, mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
RSVW_sem <- round(tapply(phenotypes$RelativeSVWeight, 
                         phenotypes$comp, calculate_sem), 3)

RSVW_stats_df <- data.frame(comp = levels(phenotypes$comp),
                            RSVW_means = RSVW_means,
                            RSVW_sem = RSVW_sem)

phenotypes <- merge(phenotypes, RSVW_stats_df, by = "comp", all = TRUE)

#calculate the mean & sem avg_area_tubule for each comparison
TA_means <- round(tapply(phenotypes$avg_area_tubule, 
                         phenotypes$comp, mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
TA_sem <- round(tapply(phenotypes$avg_area_tubule, 
                       phenotypes$comp, calculate_sem), 3)

TA_stats_df <- data.frame(comp = levels(phenotypes$comp),
                          TA_means = TA_means,
                          TA_sem = TA_sem)

phenotypes <- merge(phenotypes, TA_stats_df, by = "comp", all = TRUE)



#calculate the mean & sem avg_diameterlong_tubule for each comparison
TDL_means <- round(tapply(phenotypes$avg_diameterlong_tubule, 
                          phenotypes$comp, mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
TDL_sem <- round(tapply(phenotypes$avg_diameterlong_tubule, 
                        phenotypes$comp, calculate_sem), 3)

TDL_stats_df <- data.frame(comp = levels(phenotypes$comp),
                           TDL_means = TDL_means,
                           TDL_sem = TDL_sem)

phenotypes <- merge(phenotypes, TDL_stats_df, by = "comp", all = TRUE)



#calculate the mean & sem avg_diametershort_tubule for each comparison
TDS_means <- round(tapply(phenotypes$avg_diametershort_tubule, 
                          phenotypes$comp, mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
TDS_sem <- round(tapply(phenotypes$avg_diametershort_tubule, 
                        phenotypes$comp, calculate_sem), 3)

TDS_stats_df <- data.frame(comp = levels(phenotypes$comp),
                           TDS_means = TDS_means,
                           TDS_sem = TDS_sem)

phenotypes <- merge(phenotypes, TDS_stats_df, by = "comp", all = TRUE)



#calculate the mean & sem avg_perimeter_tubule for each comparison
TP_means <- round(tapply(phenotypes$avg_perimeter_tubule, 
                         phenotypes$comp, mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
TP_sem <- round(tapply(phenotypes$avg_perimeter_tubule, 
                       phenotypes$comp, calculate_sem), 3)

TP_stats_df <- data.frame(comp = levels(phenotypes$comp),
                          TP_means = TP_means,
                          TP_sem = TP_sem)

phenotypes <- merge(phenotypes, TP_stats_df, by = "comp", all = TRUE)

phenotypes_corr_focal_df <- phenotypes[phenotypes$strain %in% c("KN", "MBS"),]
phenotypes_corr_focal_df <- phenotypes_corr_focal_df[,c("mass", "nose2base", "tail", "length", "rt.foot", "left.ear", "testis1", "testis2", "sv", "bat", "wat", "total_count", "RelativeTestesWeight", "RelativeSVWeight", "Fat_Proportions", "Relative_Fat_Browness", "paired_TW", "Normalized_Sperm_Count", "avg_area_tubule", 
                                                        "avg_diameterlong_tubule", "avg_diametershort_tubule","avg_perimeter_tubule")]
phenotypes_corr_focal_df <- na.omit(phenotypes_corr_focal_df)

#all phenotypes
all_phenotypes_corr_matrix <- cor(phenotypes_corr_focal_df)

all_phenotypes_corr_matrix_summary <- rcorr(as.matrix(all_phenotypes_corr_matrix),
                                            type="spearman")

#male fertility correlation matrix
reproductive_traits <- c("testis1",
                         "testis2",
                         "RelativeTestesWeight",
                         "sv",
                         "RelativeSVWeight",
                         "Normalized_Sperm_Count",
                         "avg_diameterlong_tubule",
                         "avg_diametershort_tubule",
                         "avg_area_tubule")

male_fertility_corr_matrix <- cor(phenotypes_corr_focal_df[, reproductive_traits])

male_fertility_corr_matrix_summary <- rcorr(as.matrix(male_fertility_corr_matrix),
                                            type="spearman")

pdf("exported_figures/all_measurements_correlation_plot.pdf",
    height = 10, width = 10)

corrplot(all_phenotypes_corr_matrix, type = "upper", order = "hclust", 
         tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45)

dev.off()

pdf("exported_figures/male_fertility_correlation_plot.pdf",
    height = 10, width = 10)

corrplot(male_fertility_corr_matrix, type = "upper", order = "original",
         tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45)

dev.off()
```

```{r phenotype-data-visualization}
#box plots graphing parameters
point_alpha <- 0.2
point_size <- 1
vjust_value <- 0.5

# Relative Testes Weight

RelativeTestesWeight_boxplot <- ggplot(phenotypes[!is.na(phenotypes$RelativeTestesWeight),], 
                                       aes(x = acclimation, y = RelativeTestesWeight, 
                                           group=comp, color=strain, fill = strain)) + 
  geom_boxplot(width=.4, position = position_dodge(0.75), linewidth = 0.6, outliers = FALSE, alpha = 0.4, notch = FALSE, aes(color = strain)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), alpha = point_alpha, size = point_size, fill = NA) +
  scale_color_manual(values=all_pop_colors[names(all_pop_colors) %in% unique(phenotypes[!is.na(phenotypes$RelativeTestesWeight),]$strain)]) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=all_pop_colors[names(all_pop_colors) %in% unique(phenotypes[!is.na(phenotypes$RelativeTestesWeight),]$strain)]) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", 
        axis.title.x=element_blank(), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = vjust_value), 
        plot.margin = unit(c(0.4, 0.07, 0, 0.07), "cm"), 
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.length.x = unit(0, "cm"), 
        axis.ticks.length.y = unit(0, "cm")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("0 days",
```

```{r sem-plots}
# summarize fertility stats for plotting
phenotypes_summarized <- phenotypes %>%
  group_by(strain, acclimation) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    mean_RTW = mean(RelativeTestesWeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_RTW  = sd(RelativeTestesWeight, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(RelativeTestesWeight))),
    
    mean_RSVW = mean(RelativeSVWeight, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_RSVW  = sd(RelativeSVWeight, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(RelativeSVWeight))),
    
    mean_NSC = mean(Normalized_Sperm_Count, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_NSC  = sd(Normalized_Sperm_Count, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Normalized_Sperm_Count))),
    
    mean_TA = mean(avg_area_tubule, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_TA  = sd(avg_area_tubule, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(avg_area_tubule))),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# sem plots
# Relative testes weight
RelativeTestesWeight_semplot <- ggplot(phenotypes_summarized, aes(x = acclimation, y = mean_RTW, 
                                                                  color = strain, group = strain)) +
  geom_point(data = phenotypes, 
             aes(x = acclimation, y = RelativeTestesWeight, color = strain),
             alpha = point_alpha, size = point_size, inherit.aes = FALSE,
             position = position_jitterdodge(
               jitter.width = 0.1,
               jitter.height = 0,
               dodge.width = 0.75,
               seed = NA
             )) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_RTW - sem_RTW, ymax = mean_RTW + sem_RTW),
    width = 0.3,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    lineend = "round") +
```

```{r map-set-up}
# import species distribution maps; these came from IUCN redlist
dist_pero_man <- st_read(dsn = "reference_files/Space_files/redlist_species_data_24a6201f-edaf-45f8-87c7-07500d72bd9e/data_0.shp")

dist_pero_boy <- st_read(dsn = "reference_files/Space_files/redlist_species_data_2f42badb-755a-4729-8012-76a7d02b1dd9/data_0.shp")

dist_pero_leu <- st_read(dsn  = "reference_files/Space_files/redlist_species_data_cdc68519-4677-4808-8f07-046f6c7d71d0/data_0.shp")

#download geography shape files
us <- gadm("USA", level=0, path = "reference_files/US_admin_boundaries/gadm/", version="latest", resolution=1)
states <- gadm("USA", level=1, path = "reference_files/US_admin_boundaries/gadm/", version="latest", resolution=1)
colorado <- states[states$NAME_1 =="Colorado",]
nebraska <- states[states$NAME_1 =="Nebraska",]
north_carolina <- states[states$NAME_1 =="North Carolina",]
california <- states[states$NAME_1 =="California",]
michigan <- states[states$NAME_1 =="Michigan",]

#make shapefiles into sf object
us_sf <- st_as_sf(us)
pero_man_sf <- st_as_sf(dist_pero_man)
pero_boy_sf <- st_as_sf(dist_pero_boy)
pero_leu_sf <- st_as_sf(dist_pero_leu)
colorado_sf <- st_as_sf(colorado)
nebraska_sf <- st_as_sf(nebraska)
north_carolina_sf <- st_as_sf(north_carolina)
california_sf <- st_as_sf(california)
michigan_sf <- st_as_sf(michigan)

#remove great lakes from michigan
all_lakes <- sf::st_read(file.path( "reference_files/Space_files/ne_10m_lakes/ne_10m_lakes.shp"))
great_lakes <- all_lakes[all_lakes$name %in% c("Lake Superior", "Lake Michigan", "Lake Huron", "Lake  Clair", "Lake Erie"),]
great_lakes <- st_transform(great_lakes, crs = 4326)
michigan_sf <- st_difference(michigan_sf, st_union(great_lakes))

#create sf objects representing the colony locations; 
strain_localities <- read.csv("reference_files/strain_localities.csv", header = TRUE)
strain_localities_sf <- st_as_sf(strain_localities, coords = c("LONG", "LAT"), crs = 4326, agr = "constant")

#create sf object of the contiguous us and then simplify for faster plotting
#nation_object <- nation()
#saveRDS(nation_object, "reference_files/US_shape_object.rds")
nation_object <- readRDS("reference_files/US_shape_object.rds")

contiguous_us_sf <- st_crop(st_as_sf(nation_object), xmin=-35, xmax=-130, ymin=15, ymax=49)
contiguous_us_sf_simplified <- st_simplify(contiguous_us_sf, preserveTopology = FALSE, dTolerance = 1000)
contiguous_us_sf_noIsland <- ms_filter_islands(contiguous_us_sf_simplified, min_area = 12391399903)
contiguous_us_sf_noIsland <- st_transform(contiguous_us_sf_noIsland, 4326)

#create sf object of the maniculatus range in the continental US
pero_man_sf_trans <- st_transform(pero_man_sf, 4326)
pero_man_intersect_sf <- st_intersection(contiguous_us_sf_noIsland, pero_man_sf_trans)

#create sf object of the boylii range in the continental US
pero_boy_sf_trans <- st_transform(pero_boy_sf, 4326)
pero_boy_intersect_sf <- st_intersection(contiguous_us_sf_noIsland, pero_boy_sf_trans)

#create sf object of the leucopus range in the continental US
pero_leu_sf_trans <- st_transform(pero_leu_sf, 4326)
pero_leu_intersect_sf <- st_intersection(contiguous_us_sf_noIsland, pero_leu_sf_trans)

#range overlap
pero_man_leu_intersect_sf <- st_intersection(pero_man_sf, pero_leu_sf)
pero_man_leu_intersect_sf <- st_intersection(contiguous_us_sf_noIsland, pero_man_leu_intersect_sf)

#colony map
range_alpha <- 1
state_alpha <- 0.7
range_outline <- 0.1


# visualize the approximate collection sites for all strains used in the study with the p. maniculatus and p. leucopus ranges
strain_locality_map <- ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(data = pero_leu_intersect_sf, fill = leu_color, alpha = range_alpha, linewidth = range_outline, color = "black") + 
  geom_sf(data = pero_man_intersect_sf, fill = man_color, alpha = range_alpha, linewidth = range_outline, color = "black") + 
  geom_sf_pattern(data = pero_man_leu_intersect_sf,
                  aes(fill = NAMBS),
                  pattern = "stripe",
                  pattern_color = leu_color,
                  pattern_fill = leu_color,
                  fill = man_color, 
                  pattern_density = 0.5,
                  linewidth = range_outline) +
  geom_sf(data = contiguous_us_sf_noIsland, fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black") + 
  geom_sf(data = colorado_sf, fill = all_pop_colors[names(all_pop_colors) == "MBS"], 
          alpha = state_alpha, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black") + 
  geom_sf(data = nebraska_sf, fill = all_pop_colors[names(all_pop_colors) == "KN"], 
          alpha = state_alpha, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black") + 
  geom_sf(data = north_carolina_sf, fill = all_pop_colors[names(all_pop_colors) == "LL"], 
          alpha = state_alpha, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black") + 
  geom_sf(data = michigan_sf, fill = all_pop_colors[names(all_pop_colors) == "BW"], 
          alpha = state_alpha, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black") + 
  geom_sf(data = california_sf, fill = all_pop_colors[names(all_pop_colors) == "SM"], 
          alpha = state_alpha, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black") + 
  geom_sf(data = strain_localities_sf, aes(fill = strain), size = 2, pch = 21, stroke = 1, color = "black") + 
  #geom_sf_text(data = strain_localities_sf, aes(labels = strain)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = all_pop_colors) +
  coord_sf() +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "bottom")

strain_locality_map

ggsave(strain_locality_map, filename = "exported_figures/strain_locality_map.pdf")
```

```{r wilsterman-phenotypes}
# import data from wilsterman KN and MBS experiment
wil_data <- read.csv("reference_files/Wilsterman_colony_data/maleColonyRecords_Mar142026.csv", header = TRUE)

# The averageTVol column was calculatewil_data accorwil_dataing to the following equations:
##  wil_data$T1Vol <- (4/3)*pi*(as.numeric(wil_data$TL1)/2)*as.numeric(wil_data$TW1)
##  wil_data$T2Vol <- (4/3)*pi*(as.numeric(wil_data$TL2)/2)*as.numeric(wil_data$TW2)
##  wil_data$averageTVol <- rowSums(wil_data[, c("T1Vol", "T2Vol")], na.rm = TRUE) / 
##   rowSums(!is.na(wil_data[, c("T1Vol", "T2Vol")]))

# format dataframe
wil_data$Age.at.Euth <- as.numeric(wil_data$Age.at.Euth)
wil_data$Line <- gsub("MB", "MBS", wil_data$Line)
wil_data$Line <- factor(wil_data$Line, levels = c("KN", "MBS"))
wil_data$Mass..g. <- as.numeric(wil_data$Mass..g.)
wil_data$Body..length..cm. <- as.numeric(wil_data$Body..length..cm.)
wil_data <- wil_data[-which(is.na(wil_data$Line)),]

#remove wild caught individuals and individuals that unsuccessfully bred
wil_data <- wil_data[!is.na(wil_data$DOB) & wil_data$DOB != "UNK" & !grepl("WC_", wil_data$EarClipLocation),]
wil_data <- wil_data[!wil_data$cat == "Ext Unsuccessful",]

wil_data$cat <- gsub(" ", "_", wil_data$cat)
wil_data$cat <- gsub("_$", "", wil_data$cat)
wil_data$cat <- factor(wil_data$cat,
                       levels = c("No", "Ext_Successful"))

wil_data$plotGr <- gsub(" ", "_", wil_data$plotGr)
wil_data$plotGr <- gsub("_$", "", wil_data$plotGr)
wil_data$plotGr <- as.factor(paste(wil_data$Line, wil_data$cat, sep = "_"))


# calculate age ranges
paste("KN mice with same-sex sibs were on average ",
      round(mean(wil_data[wil_data$plotGr == "KN_No",]$Age.at.Euth),0),
      " +/- ",
      round(calculate_sem(wil_data[wil_data$plotGr == "KN_No",]$Age.at.Euth),0),
      " days old at the time of the experiment",
      sep = "")

paste("MBS mice with same-sex sibs were on average ",
      round(mean(wil_data[wil_data$plotGr == "MBS_No",]$Age.at.Euth),0),
      " +/- ",
      round(calculate_sem(wil_data[wil_data$plotGr == "MBS_No",]$Age.at.Euth),0),
      " days old at the time of the experiment",
      sep = "")

paste("KN mice with female exposure were on average ",
      round(mean(wil_data[wil_data$plotGr == "KN_Ext_Successful",]$Age.at.Euth),0),
      " +/- ",
      round(calculate_sem(wil_data[wil_data$plotGr == "KN_Ext_Successful",]$Age.at.Euth),0),
      " days old at the time of the experiment",
      sep = "")

paste("MBS mice with female exposure were on average ",
      round(mean(wil_data[wil_data$plotGr == "MBS_Ext_Successful",]$Age.at.Euth),0),
      " +/- ",
      round(calculate_sem(wil_data[wil_data$plotGr == "MBS_Ext_Successful",]$Age.at.Euth),0),
      " days old at the time of the experiment",
      sep = "")


wilsterman_model <- lm(averageTVol ~ Line + cat +  Body..length..cm. + Mass..g., data = wil_data)
Anova(wilsterman_model, type = "III")
check_model(wilsterman_model)
pairs(emmeans(wilsterman_model, ~Line), adjust = "BH")
pairs(emmeans(wilsterman_model, ~cat), adjust = "BH")

# visualize testis volume for each strain by female exposure category
wilsterman_RTW_plot <- ggplot(wil_data, 
                              aes(x = cat, y = averageTVol, 
                                  group = plotGr, color = Line, fill = Line)) + 
  geom_boxplot(width = .4, position = position_dodge(0.75), linewidth = 0.6,
               outliers = FALSE, alpha = 0.4, notch = FALSE,
               aes(color = Line)) +
  geom_beeswarm(aes(group = Line),
                dodge.width = 0.75,
                alpha = point_alpha, size = point_size, fill = NA,
                cex = 1,
                corral = "wrap",
                corral.width = 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values=all_pop_colors[names(all_pop_colors) %in% unique(wil_data$Line)]) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=all_pop_colors[names(all_pop_colors) %in% unique(wil_data$Line)]) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("No" = "No exposure", 
                              "Ext_Successful" = "Female exposure")) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none", 
        axis.title.x=element_blank(), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = vjust_value), 
        plot.margin = unit(c(0.4, 0.07, 0, 0.07), "cm"), 
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.length.x = unit(0, "cm"), 
        axis.ticks.length.y = unit(0, "cm")) +
  ylab("Testis volume (mm^3)") +
  xlab("Male category")
```

```{r focal-and-extended-stats}
#linear models on fertility stats for focal and extended comparisons
#RelativeTestesWeight
focal_phenotypes <- phenotypes[phenotypes$strain %in% c("KN", "MBS"),]
RelativeTestesWeight_focal_lm <- lmer(RelativeTestesWeight ~ acclimation*strain + (1|strain:family), 
                                      data = focal_phenotypes)
summary(RelativeTestesWeight_focal_lm)

RelativeTestesWeight_all_lm <- lmer(RelativeTestesWeight ~ acclimation*strain + (1|strain:family), 
                                    data = phenotypes)
summary(RelativeTestesWeight_all_lm)


RelativeTestesWeight_alt_lm <- lmer(RelativeTestesWeight ~ acclimation*elevation + (1|strain:elevation), 
                                    data = phenotypes)
summary(RelativeTestesWeight_alt_lm)


#Normalized_Sperm_Count
Normalized_Sperm_Count_focal_lm <- lmer(Normalized_Sperm_Count ~ acclimation*strain + (1|strain:family), 
                                        data = focal_phenotypes)
summary(Normalized_Sperm_Count_focal_lm)

#RelativeSVWeight
RelativeSVWeight_focal_lm <- lmer(RelativeSVWeight ~ acclimation*strain + (1|strain:family), 
                                  data = focal_phenotypes)
summary(RelativeSVWeight_focal_lm)

RelativeSVWeight_all_lm <- lmer(RelativeSVWeight ~ acclimation*strain + (1|strain:family), 
                                data = phenotypes)
summary(RelativeSVWeight_all_lm)

RelativeSVWeight_alt_lm <- lmer(RelativeSVWeight ~ acclimation*elevation + (1|strain:elevation), 
                                data = phenotypes)
summary(RelativeSVWeight_alt_lm)

#avg_area_tubule
avg_area_tubule_focal_lm <- lmer(avg_area_tubule ~ acclimation*strain + (1|strain:family), 
                                 data = focal_phenotypes)
summary(avg_area_tubule_focal_lm)
```

```{r table-S1}
# compile fertility statistics to the supplemental table spreadsheets
sentence_case <- function(x) {
  paste0(toupper(substr(x, 1, 1)), tolower(substr(x, 2, nchar(x))))
}

mice_Controls <- data.frame(table(phenotypes[phenotypes$acclimation == "Control",]$strain))
mice_2days <- data.frame(table(phenotypes[phenotypes$acclimation == "2day",]$strain))
mice_2wks <- data.frame(table(phenotypes[phenotypes$acclimation == "2wk",]$strain))
mice_6wks <- data.frame(table(phenotypes[phenotypes$acclimation == "6wk",]$strain))

#get sample sizes for each group
sample_sizes_df <- data.frame(Strain = elevations$strain,
                              Elevation = sentence_case(elevations$elevation),
                              Control = mice_Controls[mice_Controls$Var1 %in% elevations$strain,]$Freq,
                              Twoday = mice_2days[mice_2days$Var1 %in% elevations$strain,]$Freq,
                              TwoWeeks = mice_2wks[mice_2wks$Var1 %in% elevations$strain,]$Freq,
                              SixWeeks = mice_6wks[mice_6wks$Var1 %in% elevations$strain,]$Freq)

#sum sample sizes
sample_sizes_df[6,] <- c("Total", "", as.numeric(c(sum(mice_Controls$Freq),
                                                   sum(mice_2days$Freq),
                                                   sum(mice_2wks$Freq),
                                                   sum(mice_6wks$Freq))))
sample_sizes_df[,3:6] <- lapply(sample_sizes_df[,3:6], as.numeric)

sample_sizes_df$Total <- rowSums(sample_sizes_df[,3:6])


#focal_strain_models
RelativeTestesWeight_focal_sum <- summary(RelativeTestesWeight_focal_lm)
RelativeSVWeight_focal_sum <- summary(RelativeSVWeight_focal_lm)
Normalized_Sperm_Count_focal_sum <- summary(Normalized_Sperm_Count_focal_lm)
avg_area_tubule_focal_sum <- summary(avg_area_tubule_focal_lm)

# add coefficiences, betas, SEMs, and p-values to one dataframe for export
focal_strain_models <- data.frame(focal_coefficients = rownames(RelativeTestesWeight_focal_sum$coefficients),
                                  RTW_beta = round(data.frame(RelativeTestesWeight_focal_sum$coefficients)$Estimate, 3),
                                  RTW_SE = round(data.frame(RelativeTestesWeight_focal_sum$coefficients)$Std..Error, 3),
                                  RTW_p = round(data.frame(RelativeTestesWeight_focal_sum$coefficients)$Pr...t.., 3),
                                  
                                  RSV_beta = round(data.frame(RelativeSVWeight_focal_sum$coefficients)$Estimate, 3),
                                  RSV_SE = round(data.frame(RelativeSVWeight_focal_sum$coefficients)$Std..Error, 3),
                                  RSV_p = round(data.frame(RelativeSVWeight_focal_sum$coefficients)$Pr...t.., 3),
                                  
                                  NSC_beta = round(data.frame(Normalized_Sperm_Count_focal_sum$coefficients)$Estimate, 3),
                                  NSC_SE = round(data.frame(Normalized_Sperm_Count_focal_sum$coefficients)$Std..Error, 3),
                                  NSC_p = round(data.frame(Normalized_Sperm_Count_focal_sum$coefficients)$Pr...t.., 3),
                                  
                                  ATA_beta = round(data.frame(avg_area_tubule_focal_sum$coefficients)$Estimate, 3),
                                  ATA_SE = round(data.frame(avg_area_tubule_focal_sum$coefficients)$Std..Error, 3),
                                  ATA_p = round(data.frame(avg_area_tubule_focal_sum$coefficients)$Pr...t.., 3)
)

#all_strain_models
RelativeTestesWeight_all_sum <- summary(RelativeTestesWeight_all_lm)
RelativeSVWeight_all_sum <- summary(RelativeSVWeight_all_lm)

all_strain_models <- data.frame(all_coefficients = rownames(RelativeTestesWeight_all_sum$coefficients),
                                RTW_beta = round(data.frame(RelativeTestesWeight_all_sum$coefficients)$Estimate, 3),
                                RTW_SE = round(data.frame(RelativeTestesWeight_all_sum$coefficients)$Std..Error, 3),
                                RTW_p = round(data.frame(RelativeTestesWeight_all_sum$coefficients)$Pr...t.., 3),
                                
                                RSV_beta = round(data.frame(RelativeSVWeight_all_sum$coefficients)$Estimate, 3),
                                RSV_SE = round(data.frame(RelativeSVWeight_all_sum$coefficients)$Std..Error, 3),
                                RSV_p = round(data.frame(RelativeSVWeight_all_sum$coefficients)$Pr...t.., 3)
)


#alt_strain_models
RelativeTestesWeight_alt_sum <- summary(RelativeTestesWeight_alt_lm)
RelativeSVWeight_alt_sum <- summary(RelativeSVWeight_alt_lm)

alt_strain_models <- data.frame(alt_coefficients = rownames(RelativeTestesWeight_alt_sum$coefficients),
                                RTW_beta = round(data.frame(RelativeTestesWeight_alt_sum$coefficients)$Estimate, 3),
                                RTW_SE = round(data.frame(RelativeTestesWeight_alt_sum$coefficients)$Std..Error, 3),
                                RTW_p = round(data.frame(RelativeTestesWeight_alt_sum$coefficients)$Pr...t.., 3),
                                
                                RSV_beta = round(data.frame(RelativeSVWeight_alt_sum$coefficients)$Estimate, 3),
                                RSV_SE = round(data.frame(RelativeSVWeight_alt_sum$coefficients)$Std..Error, 3),
                                RSV_p = round(data.frame(RelativeSVWeight_alt_sum$coefficients)$Pr...t.., 3)
)

# Put your dataframes in a named list — names become sheet names
supplemental_tables <- list(
  "Sample sizes" = sample_sizes_df,
  "All strain models" = all_strain_models,
  "Elevation models" = alt_strain_models,
  "Focal strain models" = focal_strain_models
)

# export to excel
write.xlsx(supplemental_tables, file = "exported_files/phenotype_statistical_models.xlsx")
```
